$comment: The committed record of what the conformance suite asserts. A test fails if the live registry and this file disagree, so removing, renaming or re-gating a contract is a reviewable diff rather than a silent deletion.

checks.C01: control plane: the unit describes itself
checks.C02: capabilities: every route is owned, every surface capability is used
checks.C03: capabilities: a disabled capability answers explicitly, never 404
checks.C04: errors: the framework never answers a consumer
checks.C05: errors: the vendor shaper covers every core error kind
checks.C06: state: the seed scenario is deterministic across two fresh units
checks.C07: state: the journal is append-only and versions never go backwards
checks.C08: chaos: identical rules and identical traffic produce identical outcomes
checks.C09: webhooks: signing is deterministic and matches the declared bindings
checks.C10: transport: the HTTP and in-process bindings agree byte for byte
checks.C11: capabilities: every core-gated capability is declared or explicitly excused
checks.C12: chaos: a one-shot trigger mutates neither configuration nor counters
checks.C13: state: self-transitions are illegal unless declared, terminal states are immutable
checks.C14: chaos: an in-band trigger respects the capability gate
checks.C15: transport: a form-encoded body reaches the handler as fields
checks.C16: webhooks: the core brands no delivery header, and the retry metadata is the vendor's
checks.C17: auth: a credential is required, honoured, and checked for scope
checks.C18: webhooks: the delivery capability gate is real, at the point of delivery
checks.C19: state: a replayed idempotency key returns the stored answer and runs nothing
checks.C20: state: a cursor belongs to the query that issued it
checks.C21: webhooks: the declared retry schedule is the schedule actually followed
checks.C22: state: the seed scenario is deterministic across two OPERATING-SYSTEM PROCESSES
checks.C23: transport: a repeated query parameter reaches the handler whole
checks.C33: control plane: an unmatched request is named and recorded
